content.todaysFocus: Avi is 25 days old, inside the 1-month milestone window. The priority this week is logging early head-lifting and watching for the first true social smile, which typically lands between weeks 4 and 6.

actionItems.body: Run tummy time at 15-20 minutes cumulative today, broken into short bouts after feeds when he is alert. Lay him on your chest at a slight incline to lower the protest in these early weeks.
actionItems.sourceLabel: AAP Back to Sleep, Tummy to Play

actionItems.body: Schedule the 1-month well visit if it is not already booked; the window is day 28-35 and you want it on the calendar before the weekend.
Start a feeding and output log now so the pediatrician can plot growth on the WHO curves at the 1-month visit.

watchFors: [low concern] Evening fussiness clustering around 5-8pm is the normal witching hour; cradle cap and a single continuously tearing eye with no redness are also benign at this age.

[monitor] Crying that exceeds 3 hours a day, more than 3 days a week, for 3 weeks fits the Wessel definition of colic; document the pattern but expect a peak near week 6 and resolution by 12-16 weeks.

[call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting paired with weight loss can signal pyloric stenosis; persistent arching and inability to console during feeds warrants a same-day conversation about GERD versus milk-protein intolerance.
[call now] A rectal temperature of 100.4F or higher, blue color around the lips with crying, or any seizure-like activity is an emergency under 90 days; call the pediatrician or 911 now!

enrichment.body: Position him on your chest at a slight incline for tummy time so face-tracking motivates the head lift while the angle eases the load on his neck.
Get face-to-face within 8-12 inches, exaggerate your expression, and hold it; the directed social smile he is working toward emerges weeks 4-6.
enrichment.sourceLabel: AAP movement birth to three months

enrichment.body: Begin a daily 10-15 minute read-aloud with a rotating 3-5 board-book set such as Black on White and Brown Bear, Brown Bear; the rhythm and cadence are the active ingredients now.

upcoming: Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; bring the feeding and output log
Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; vaccines HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1
Day 57-72: post-2-month-vaccine window; expect 24-48h of fussiness, drowsiness, and low-grade fever

content.todaysFocus: At 26 days Avi prefers human faces and bold contrast over everything else, and he is starting to recognize your voices. Today leans into visual fixation and the back-and-forth that builds language.

actionItems.body: Run a short high-contrast card session today, holding bold black-and-white cards 8-12 inches from his face and letting him lock on and track.
Confirm the 400 IU/day vitamin D supplement is in his daily routine; AAP advises it for breastfed and predominantly breastfed infants regardless of how much daylight he gets.
If you are returning to work at 12 or 16 weeks, start daycare and nanny research in earnest this week; top Bay Area daycares run 6-18 month waitlists and nanny searches take 4-8 weeks.

watchFors: [low concern] Wet sneezing, hiccups after feeds, and a quiet startle at loud sounds are all normal reflex activity at this stage.
[monitor] Frequent painful spit-up with arching during or after feeds, or feed refusal despite clear hunger cues, may point to GERD or cow's-milk-protein intolerance; note it for the 1-month visit.
[call within 24h] A persistent inability to console combined with back-arching during feeds should be raised same-day to sort severe reflux from milk-protein intolerance.
[call now] A rectal temperature of 100.4F or higher, cyanosis around the lips, or seizure-like movement means call the pediatrician or 911 right now!

enrichment.body: Hold high-contrast black-and-white cards 8-12 inches out and move them slowly side to side; at this age he prefers faces and bold contrast, so let him fixate before you shift.
Answer every coo as if he spoke a full sentence, pause, then answer his next sound; this serve-and-return turn-taking is the pattern Romeo et al. linked to stronger later language.

Take a 20-30 minute daylight stroller walk for varied sensory input and your own cardiovascular recovery; the outdoor light and motion are good input even though the vitamin D supplement does the nutritional work.

upcoming: Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; bring the feeding and output log
Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; vaccines HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1
Day 57-72: post-2-month-vaccine window; expect 24-48h of fussiness and low-grade fever

content.todaysFocus: Day 27 closes out week 4. The high-leverage move today is turning ordinary caregiving into dense language and music exposure, since the serve-and-return cadence is what compounds.

actionItems.body: Narrate the next diaper change step by step in warm, sing-song speech; routine tasks are some of the densest language exposure he gets, and Romeo et al. tied conversational turns to later language outcomes.
Confirm the 1-month well visit is on the books for the day 28-35 window if you have not locked it in yet.
Pre-write Anoushka's questions for the 6-week postpartum OB visit now: pelvic floor symptoms, mood, contraception, and the timeline for returning to exercise.

watchFors: [low concern] Increasing evening fussiness and a blocked tear duct that weeps from one eye without redness are both common and need no action.
[monitor] Track any crying that trends toward 3-plus hours a day across multiple days; this is the run-up to the week-6 crying peak, and coping strategies matter more than a colic label.
[call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting with poor weight gain warrants a same-day call to rule out pyloric stenosis.
[call now] A rectal temperature of 100.4F or higher, blue lips while crying, or any seizure-like activity is an emergency under 90 days; call the pediatrician or 911 now!

enrichment.body: Narrate the diaper change in full sentences with a sing-song lilt; describing each step turns a daily chore into rich language input.
Add a football-hold tummy-time variant, draping him belly-down along your forearm, to vary the position as you build toward 20-30 minutes a day.
Sing live during the change rather than playing a recording; the serve-and-return cadence drives the benefit, not the polish of the song.

upcoming: Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; bring the feeding and output log
Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; vaccines HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1
Day 57-72: post-2-month-vaccine window; expect 24-48h of fussiness and low-grade fever

content.todaysFocus: Avi is 28 days old and entering week 5, near the peak of the PURPLE crying curve. The action item is closing out the 1-month well check; inconsolable evenings this week are expected, not pathological.

actionItems.body: Schedule the 1-month well visit today if it is not already booked, and bring a feeding and output log so the pediatrician can plot growth on the WHO curves.
Pre-schedule the 2-month visit for the day 56-70 window now; that round delivers HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, and IPV #1.
Keep daycare tours and nanny interviews active this week if Anoushka or Noah is returning to work in the next 7-11 weeks.

watchFors: [low concern] Inconsolable evening crying with no clear trigger is classic PURPLE crying; the 5 S's of swaddle, side or stomach hold, shush, swing, and suck help most infants settle.
[monitor] Bloody or mucus-streaked stool can suggest milk-protein intolerance or an anal fissure; document it and let the pediatrician distinguish the two.
[call within 24h] Sustained refusal of multiple feeds in a row warrants a same-day call.

[call now] A rectal temperature of 100.4F or higher, apnea or color change, or inconsolable high-pitched crying with lethargy and a bulging fontanelle is an emergency; call the pediatrician or 911 now!

enrichment.body: Lean in close, brighten your whole face, and reward any flicker of a smile with obvious delight; consolidating social smiles is the week-5 social milestone.
Read the same 3-5 board books on rotation rather than constantly new titles; the repetition is what lets rhythm and predictability start to register.
Keep tummy time at 20-30 minutes cumulative across short bouts, using the forearm football hold for variety when floor time draws protest.

upcoming: Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; bring the feeding and output log
Day 35-41: Anoushka's 6-week postpartum OB visit; expect exercise clearance, contraception, and an EPDS screen
Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; vaccines HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1

content.todaysFocus: At 29 days Avi is still near the crying peak, so today pairs one forward-looking logistics task with low-stimulation enrichment. Bay Area parent-baby swim classes carry real lead time worth claiming now.

actionItems.body: Get on a Bay Area parent-baby swim waitlist today; most classes start around 3-6 months, so the lead time is the reason to act this far ahead.
Confirm the 1-month visit is complete with growth and feeding tracking, and that the 2-month visit is pre-scheduled inside the day 56-70 window.
Have a written shaken-baby plan ready for the crying peak: if you feel the urge, put Avi down safely in the crib, step away for 10 minutes, and call your partner or a friend.

watchFors: [low concern] Vowel sounds like ah and eh beginning to emerge, and visible settling when full, are expected week-5 progress.
[monitor] Forceful arching during or after feeds with frequent painful spit-up may indicate GERD or milk-protein intolerance; raise it at the 1-month or 2-month visit.
[call within 24h] Bloody stool with mucus streaks should prompt a same-day call to distinguish milk-protein intolerance from a fissure.
[call now] A rectal temperature of 100.4F or higher, apnea or a color change, or seizure-like activity is an emergency under 90 days; call the pediatrician or 911 now!

enrichment.body: Waitlist a Bay Area parent-baby swim class now; booking ahead of the typical 3-6 month start age is the difference between a prime slot and a year delay.
Set up a high-contrast mobile over the changing area at his eye line to draw fixation and early tracking during the minutes he spends there.
Run forearm tummy time on a firm mat with a rolled blanket tucked under his chest for support, which lets him practice head lifts with less strain.

upcoming: Day 35-41: Anoushka's 6-week postpartum OB visit; exercise clearance, contraception, and EPDS screen
Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; vaccines HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1
Day 57-72: post-2-month-vaccine window; expect 24-48h of fussiness and low-grade fever
